Target the 8 anchor: four nacelles hung under the swept wings on visible pylons, plausible inboard/outboard spacing; then the 10 anchor: four underslung pylon-mounted nacelles with correct relative size, spacing, and forward offset ahead of the wing leading edge, inlet visibly open/darker.
